name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: The 'better copies to review' quality-upgrade panel now shows cover art on every title, groups a TV show's episode candidates under the show itself (selecting the show selects all its episodes), and supports selecting several candidates and applying them together in one request instead of one at a time - gated behind two confirmations. Downloading/replacing content on this server remains temporarily disabled while that flow is reworked, so nothing is actually downloaded or removed yet; this is the review/selection UI ahead of that.
